clin['ethnicity_group'] = clin['ethnicity'].map({
    'HISPANIC OR LATINO': 'Hispanic',
    'NOT HISPANIC OR LATINO': 'Non-Hispanic'
})
# Define survival time and event
clin['time'] = clin['days_to_death'].fillna(clin['days_to_last_followup'])
clin['event'] = (clin['vital_status'] == 'Dead').astype(int)
# Drop rows with missing time
clin = clin.dropna(subset=['time'])

# Report patient counts
print("Patient counts by ethnicity group:")
print(clin['ethnicity_group'].value_counts(), "\n")

# Kaplan-Meier curves

plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))

})
